A procedural approach to generating DOF rays using noise buffers and distance-based offsets.
It generates an offset using a noise buffer and lens distance, transforms it to world space, and calculates the new ray direction and origin based on the distance to focus.
It performs AABB intersection on the resulting rays.
A post-processing effect that simulates polygonal aperture diffraction patterns (star burst) using exponentially weighted line kernels.
